verdict.rationale: Cekura publishes a documented public API with OpenAPI spec (probe confirms live openapi.json), API key auth, dedicated API reference endpoints (e.g. send-calls), plus SDKs (sync/async) and a CLI for programmatic/terminal control—clearly enabling an AI-native user to drive the product via documented API access. Missing for 10: independent third-party review/hands-on validation of the API beyond vendor docs and probes.
